title: Doomsday Survivor
description: Weave through swarms of urban zombies with one-finger joystick movement, auto-firing evolving weapons, bombs, and magnets in intense roguelite survival.
controls: Drag anywhere on screen to move your agent with the virtual joystick; weapons fire automatically while you dodge swarms and pick level-up skills.

zh-CN.title: 末日特工队
zh-CN.description: 高爽感单手肉鸽清屏割草：虚拟摇杆走位躲避尸潮，自动释放进化武器、清屏炸弹与吸铁石，满屏收割超解压。
zh-CN.controls: 按住屏幕任意位置滑动虚拟摇杆移动特工，角色自动攻击敌人，拾取经验宝石升级选择强力割草技能。
